name: Waypurse
summary: Business wallets in four currencies, with live rates and money that pours between them
about: A money app for a business that sells abroad and keeps money in four currencies, shown with a leather exporter's sample data. Bold colour blocks hold each wallet, a flow chart shows sales pouring into wallets and out to costs, and converting money locks a live rate for 30 seconds before coins pour from one wallet into the other. It also sends payments abroad with a review step, gives local account details and payment links, tracks invoices, rate alerts and cards.
how: Switch the base currency on Wallets and watch every total and chart change
Type an amount on Convert, lock the rate, then convert to see the money pour across
Pay a recipient abroad from any wallet; the review shows the rate and what they get
Copy local account details for each currency, or make and delete payment links
Watch live rates tick on Rates and set an alert that fires when a pair crosses a level
Filter activity by currency, mark invoices paid, freeze a card or change its wallet
